title: Heterogeneous olefin metathesis reference family
reaction: 2 RCH=CH2 -> RCH=CHR + CH2=CH2 (cross / self-metathesis) | C2H4 + 2-C4H8 -> 2 C3H6 (ethylene + butene to propylene)
objective: Optional literature-backed family for heterogeneous olefin metathesis. Candidates compare a Re2O7 / Al2O3 mild-condition anchor (oleochemistry / lab-scale), a WO3 / SiO2 industrial OCT-style propylene route (Lummus OCT / Korea Petrochemical), and a MoO3 / Al2O3-SiO2 alkane-metathesis emerging variant.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Balance catalyst cost, evidence quality, route maturity, and reported metathesis activity / selectivity.

cost-first.label: Cost-first
cost-first.description: Bias ranking toward catalyst cost while preserving route and evidence guardrails.

evidence-first.label: Evidence-first
evidence-first.description: Reward stronger literature support and reproducible metathesis routes.

citations.label: Green Chem. 2002
citations.note: Mol: application of olefin metathesis in oleochemistry, foundational green-chemistry reference for fatty-acid metathesis using Re2O7.

citations.label: Chem. Lett. 2002
citations.note: Onaka and Oikawa: olefin metathesis over mesoporous alumina-supported rhenium oxide catalyst, mild-condition Re2O7 reference.

citations.label: J. Mol. Catal. A 2004
citations.note: Mol: foundational review (840+ citations) of industrial applications of olefin metathesis, covering Re / Mo / W heterogeneous and Ru / Mo homogeneous routes.

citations.label: Catal. Lett. 2004
citations.note: Primary abstract reports organized mesoporous alumina with an optimum 9-15 wt% elemental Re; this does not verify the screened 8 wt% Re or generic alumina grade.

citations.label: Appl. Catal. A 2006
citations.note: Primary study of molybdena on alumina, silica-alumina and silica, prepared by thermal spreading of MoO2(acac)2 and tested in propene metathesis; this is not a WO3/SiO2 study.

citations.label: Adv. Synth. Catal. 2007
citations.note: Tungsten-based silica-alumina-supported alkane metathesis study; context only, not direct evidence for molybdena olefin metathesis or its screened loading.

citations.label: Chem. Commun. 2017
citations.note: Well-defined Mo oxo alkyl species grafted onto silica dehydroxylated at 200 C; an active-site model using surface organometallic chemistry, not the generic MoO3/silica-alumina impregnation recipe.

citations.label: Angew. Chem. Int. Ed. 2007
citations.note: Supported tungsten hydride on alumina converts ethylene directly to propylene in one continuous-flow reactor via trifunctional single-site catalysis.

citations.label: ACS Catal. 2014
citations.note: Review of supported ReOx, MoOx and WOx metathesis catalysts.

route_templates.name: Re2O7 / Al2O3 mild-condition route
route_templates.manufacturing_mode: Rhenium-oxide on alumina metathesis catalyst preparation
route_templates.route_note: Most transferable mild-condition metathesis basis using Re2O7 / Al2O3; Re economics dominate. Small-scale step availability: kiln_continuous_indirect swapped for kiln_batch.

route_templates.name: WO3 / SiO2 industrial OCT route
route_templates.manufacturing_mode: Tungsten-oxide on silica metathesis catalyst (industrial OCT)
route_templates.route_note: Industrial WO3 / SiO2 metathesis route used in Lummus OCT for on-purpose propylene; high temperatures, mature process.

route_templates.name: MoO3 / SiO2-Al2O3 emerging route
route_templates.route_note: MoO3 / silica-alumina emerging metathesis route; intermediate-temperature option between Re2O7 (mild) and WO3 (high-T).

route_templates.name: Surface-organometallic tungsten hydride grafting
preprocess: High-temperature dehydroxylation of the alumina support
synthesis: Grafting of the tungsten organometallic precursor under inert atmosphere
route_templates.route_note: Surface organometallic chemistry has no direct step-library analogue; the multistep-reactor rate proxies the grafting train and the air-free handling burden sits in the non-step charge.

candidates.title: Re2O7 / Al2O3 mild-condition
candidates.summary: Re2O7 on alumina, the canonical mild-condition heterogeneous metathesis catalyst widely used in oleochemistry and lab-scale work.
decision_notes: Best fit when mild-condition metathesis is required and Re economics are acceptable.
Catalyst economics dominated by Re; Al2O3 support is a small fraction of cost.

The screened 8 wt% is elemental Re, not Re2O7 mass. The Balcar primary abstract reports an optimum 9-15 wt% Re on organized mesoporous alumina; loading, pore structure and the 25-100 C window are retained as proxy inputs.
Performance, readiness and route scores are authored screening assessments, not measured conversion, selectivity or lifetime; price-evidence scores assess pricing provenance separately.

pricing.note: Annual average rhenium metal pellet price 2024, $1,370/kg = $621.42/lb (USGS MCS 2025). Replaces a live-feed reference to a symbol the price service does not carry. Former live-feed precursor markup (1.10) folded out; the public quote stands alone.

Gamma-alumina support cost held on engineering proxy. USGS MCS 2026 metallurgical alumina (2025e $590/t import value, ~$0.27/lb) is the public floor; catalyst-grade premium retained. UN Comtrade 2024: calcined alumina (HS 281820) averaged $0.60/kg with specialty flows to $3.64/kg; catalyst-carrier activated/gamma alumina marketplace offers run $800-1,700/t.

candidates.title: WO3 / SiO2 (Lummus OCT)
candidates.summary: Supported tungsten-oxide screening archetype for ethylene/2-butene metathesis to propylene; this is not a verified proprietary OCT catalyst formulation.
decision_notes: The 7 wt% cost input is elemental W, not WO3 mass. Silica grade, the 300-450 C window and industrial manufacturing assumptions were not verified against a licensor recipe.
The Handzlik molybdena study does not validate this tungsten catalyst; retained reviews supply industrial and supported-oxide context only.
Performance, readiness and route scores are authored screening assessments, not measured conversion, selectivity or lifetime; price-evidence scores assess pricing provenance separately.

pricing.note: Live W feed with a precursor / conversion markup; WO3 active phase derives from calcined ammonium tungstate.
Silica support cost held on engineering proxy comparable to commercial silica gel ranges.

candidates.title: MoO3 / SiO2-Al2O3 emerging
candidates.summary: MoO3 on silica-alumina mixed support, an intermediate-temperature metathesis route between Re2O7 (mild) and WO3 (high-T).
decision_notes: The Handzlik primary study directly examines Mo on silica-alumina using thermal spreading of MoO2(acac)2, not the screened generic wet route. The 8 wt% input is elemental Mo, not MoO3.

Merle studies grafted Mo species on silica rather than silica-alumina; the W alkane-metathesis paper is not direct evidence for this candidate. Exact support composition, loading and the 100-300 C screening window remain assumptions.
Performance, readiness and route scores are authored screening assessments, not measured conversion, selectivity or lifetime; price-evidence scores assess pricing provenance separately.

pricing.note: Live Mo feed with a precursor / conversion markup; MoO3 active phase derives from calcined ammonium molybdate.
Silica-alumina mixed support cost held on engineering proxy averaged between silica and alumina baselines.

candidates.title: W-H/Al2O3 single-site hydride
candidates.summary: A grafted tungsten hydride that dimerizes, isomerizes and cross-metathesizes in one bed - direct ethylene-to-propylene without a butene co-feed, at surface-organometallic manufacturing cost.
decision_notes: Screens the feed-simplification upside (no 2-butene loop) against a lab-bound air-free synthesis.
Operating conditions are not stated in the fetched abstract; the window shown is the mild band this chemistry targets. W loading screened at 4 wt%.

The title and primary bibliographic record support the tungsten-hydride/ethylene-to-propylene architecture. Free full experimental conditions and the 4 wt% W recipe were not verified; metal-price markup does not establish the cost of air-free organometallic precursor preparation.
Performance, readiness and route scores are authored screening assessments, not measured conversion, selectivity or lifetime; price-evidence scores assess pricing provenance separately.

pricing.note: Live W feed with an elevated markup for the organometallic precursor route; loading is a screening assumption.
2025 USGS alumina import value used as a bulk oxide support proxy.
